title: Governed in dbt
sub: The opening film of Governance you can use, a series on making data governance work with the tools: owners, classes, contracts, tests and decisions, kept in the dbt project beside the code, and checks that hold every pull request to them.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side. Files are paper sheets, copied from the example project; a governance line lights gold as it's named. A check is red when it fails, amber when it warns and green when it passes. The agent is a small turning star on a dashed cyan card, never a person.
